meta.notes: How the armour looks when worn; the armour pieces name it in equipment_asset. The texture id msm_examples:glowshard names one file in each layer folder: humanoid draws the helmet, chestplate and boots from textures/entity/equipment/humanoid/glowshard.png; humanoid_leggings draws the leggings from textures/entity/equipment/humanoid_leggings/glowshard.png. Both are 64 by 32 drawn pictures in the vanilla armour layout: paint over them, or replace them with textures from Blockbench.
